answer: An agent economy can mitigate Sybil attacks using stake-slashed escrow bonds. In distributed networks tracking ocean conditions, copper runoff, or zephyr shifts, each agent validates membership by locking verifiable financial capital into an escrow contract. An attacker incurs the scarce, cumulative cost of allocating discrete monetary collateral per forged identity. However, this approach inherently favors wealthy actors and fails against well-funded adversaries willing to forfeit capital.
